results.text: Good day, and thank you for standing by. [#0](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-0)
Welcome to the First Half 2024 Results Presentation. [#1](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-1)
[Operator Instructions] Please be advised that today's conference is being recorded. [#2](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-2)
I'd now like to hand the conference over to your first speaker today, Mr. Martire, CEO. [#3](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-3)
Please go ahead. [#4](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-4)
Thank you. [#6](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-6)
Good afternoon, and welcome to Elis H1 2024 results presentation. [#7](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-7)
I am Xavier Martire, CEO of Elis. [#8](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-8)
And here in Paris with our CFO, Louis Guyot. [#9](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-9)
After an overview of Elis' half year highlights, I will hand over to Louis. [#10](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-10)
He will detail the results for the first half. [#11](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-11)

I will then come back to provide you with an update on our CSR journey and our strategy before updating you on our upward revision of our full year outlook. [#12](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-12)
Finally, we will have a Q&A session to answer your question. [#13](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-13)
And after our call, Nicolas Buron, will be available to answer any of your questions off-line. [#14](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-14)
Before we start, please take the time to read the disclaimer. [#15](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-15)

So I'm very happy to report very solid financial performance in the first half with sound revenue growth, marked improvement EBITDA margin and good cash generation. [#17](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-17)

Top line momentum was strong with a growth of plus 6.9% in of which 5.5% on an organic basis to reach nearly EUR 2.5 billion, a record number for Elis for first half. [#18](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-18)
EBITDA reached EUR 774 million, with EBITDA margin up plus 120 basis points at 34.5%. [#19](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-19)
EBIT came at EUR 344 million, with EBIT margin up plus 20 bps at 15.3%. [#20](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-20)
Headline net income per share was up 1.6% and reached EUR 0.83 on a fully diluted basis. [#21](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-21)
Free cash flow was good for the first half at more than EUR 55 million. [#22](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-22)
Bearing in mind that Elis traditionally generates most of its free cash in the second half of the year. [#23](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-23)

Finally, the financial leverage ratio at the end of June was at 2.06x, which puts us on track to achieve our full year guidance of 1.8x in the first half, our commercial activity was well oriented, and we continue to sign many new contracts in all our geographies as a result of new outsourcing and growing needs in hygiene, traceability of products and sustainable services. [#24](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-24)

Pricing remains solid to offset the -- to inflation of our cost base, and I'm happy to report that we recorded a good evolution of our churn with client retention returning to where it was before the very unusual inflation year we had in '23. [#26](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-26)
We -- I will give you more detail in this presentation. [#27](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-27)
Finally, we continue to deliver significant productivity gains, thanks to better efficiency in our plants and improve logistics. [#28](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-28)

This good first half performance and the visibility we have in the second half allow us to upgrade our organic growth and EBITDA margin objectives for the full year, and we confirm with great comfort all the other objectives that we gave in March. [#29](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-29)
I will come back to this at the end of the presentation. [#30](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-30)
Moving on to the next slide. [#32](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-32)

Revenue growth in H1 was driven by strong commercial activity in workwear with many new contracts signed, Central Europe and Southern Europe were both especially well oriented and benefited from the ongoing outsourcing trend in many industry end markets. [#33](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-33)

In the first half, we maintained a very strict pricing policy to offset the inflation of our cost base, which is mainly driven by the increase in salaries. [#34](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-34)

As far as energy prices are concerned, the hedging we gradually put in place since '22 led to a favorable effect in the first half with the overall inflation of our cost base below our average price increase. [#35](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-35)
Overall, inflation is slowing down in all geographies, so we expect a slight decrease in the pricing effect going forward. [#36](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-36)
In the first half, despite continued strong pricing discipline, we managed to improve our churn. [#37](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-37)
This normalization of the retention rate clearly underscores the very tight relationship Elis enjoys with its clients. [#38](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-38)
However, the contract loss last year had a mechanical carryforward effect in the first half of 2024. [#39](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-39)
In hospitality, the picture is mixed. [#41](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-41)
Occupancy rates are higher in Southern Europe with projected record numbers in Spain for the summer. [#42](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-42)

The U.K. and France were more disappointing as bad weather in May and June as well as the general elections organized in both countries had a negative impact on activities. [#43](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-43)

Furthermore, as of now, the Olympics have had a negative effect on activity in Paris with several professional events originally scheduled in June deferred to September or October. [#44](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-44)

M&A had a plus 1% impact in H1 '24 revenue growth corresponding to plus EUR 22 million uplift, essentially driven by the acquisition of Moderna consolidated from the beginning of '24. [#45](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-45)
Lastly, FX had a plus 0.4% impact on revenue in mostly driven by the evolution of the pound and the Mexican pesos. [#46](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-46)
Moving on to the next slide. [#47](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-47)
We continue to deploy our services in all our geographies and commercial momentum was good in the first half of the year. [#48](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-48)

the growing need for more hygiene as well as the European regulation that changed market standards results in a steady development of the outsourcing. [#49](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-49)

Our circular services perfectly address these evolving needs, and we continue to record many successes in workwear and with small clients. [#50](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-50)

More generally, we continue to roll out the offering of our services to SMEs when our network density allowed it as our ability to efficiently sell small clients is essentially linked to the density we have in a specific country. [#52](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-52)

Furthermore, the post-COVID environment remains very favorable for is with an increasing need for hygiene in general, notably for pest control and the clean room business, which delivered more than 10% organic growth over the last few years and continued to record very strong growth in the first half. [#53](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-53)
Pest control is a perfect example of a margin accretive service that we added to our offering. [#54](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-54)

Over time, we have signed many pest control contracts with existing customers leveraging our strong commercial relationship and second to non-network density. [#55](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-55)
Even in more mature markets such as Hospitality. [#56](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-56)

Healthcare, opportunities are there, thanks to the development of nursing home markets and the steady trend of new hotel openings in Europe. [#57](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-57)

All these opportunities have been identified by early in the cycle, and we are currently reinforcing our sales force in many countries to capture an even bigger piece of this growing cake. [#58](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-58)
The total investment represents a cost of around EUR 20 million in '24. [#59](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-59)
Moving on to the next slide. [#61](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-61)
One big achievement of the first was churn level rate to 6% at group level. [#62](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-62)

As a reminder, we saw a 1 point increase in '23 as a result of the significant price increase we had to pass to offset the increase in our cost base. [#63](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-63)

In some very hard cases, some clients, most of them being public entities in Central Europe and Scandinavia did not recognize a very unusual situation we were going through and had us to enter pricing negotiations. [#64](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-64)
We then decided not to renew these contracts or even terminate them when we could. [#65](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-65)
In the first half of '24, things returned to normal, thanks to our first-class quality service. [#66](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-66)

The close commercial relationship we have with our customers and the fact that our services, which are essential to our clients' activity generally represent form fraction of their P&L. [#67](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-67)

We monitor our clients satisfaction using a set of tools, an independent department at Elis, notably run thousands of direct interviews every year. [#69](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-69)
In the first half, we reached score close to 90%, a record level. [#70](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-70)

These good results are perfectly consistent with all the internal KPIs we track regarding service quality, such as the speed at which we actually start to operate a contract once it has been signed or the in-full metric which module the accuracy of the quantity of linen delivered compared to what was ordered and all the have shown some good progress in the first half, and we'll keep up the good work. [#71](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-71)
Let's now take a look at each of our geographic France first, where revenue growth was entirely organic at plus 3.6% in the first half. [#72](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-72)
This was driven by commercial momentum in workwear especially in Industry, for Industry and Trade & Services. [#73](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-73)

However, hospitality activity was impacted in Q2 by poor weather in May and June the Olympics preparation in Paris and the general ad exchange, which seems to have somewhat limited weekend trips. [#74](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-74)
Furthermore, several professional events such as company seminars have been scheduled from Q2 to September or October. [#76](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-76)
This, along with a good level of bookings led our hospitality clients quite optimistic for the second half of the year. [#77](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-77)

EBITDA margin was up plus 190 bps to reach nearly 41%, thanks to the neutral balance of inflationary impacts and some further productivity gains, especially on logistics and energy consumptions. [#78](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-78)
Finally, margin also benefited from the stable level of fixed costs, which creates some operating leverage. [#79](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-79)
Moving on to the next slide. [#80](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-80)

Our stock price lost around 15% since the dissolution of the French National Assembly, which seems exaggerated given the actual risk that this political instability represents for -- so what would be the impact of a potential shift in the French economy policy. [#81](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-81)

First, the increase in medium wage would translate into inflation of our cost base, and I believe we have proven on many occasions, our ability to efficiently reflect the inflation in our pricing. [#82](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-82)

With that in mind, we could expect an additional revenue increase of between 1% to 2%, resulting from higher pricing with stable margin percentage. [#83](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-83)

Second, in case of a significant slowdown in France GDP, revenue should remain stable due to the high diversification in terms of end markets and the fact that a large part of our revenue in the country correspond to monthly fixed fee invoicing. [#85](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-85)
Looking at what happened back in 2009 during the last big economic crisis. [#86](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-86)
We would expect to lose between 1 and 2 percentage points on revenue in France. [#87](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-87)

Furthermore, we clearly demonstrated during the last pandemic our ability to quickly adjust our cost structure in case of a meaningful activity slowdown. [#88](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-88)
So we would not expect any margin impact or free cash flow shortfall. [#89](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-89)
Therefore, we believe that even a significant political ship in France will not have any major impact for us. [#90](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-90)
Moving on to the next slide. [#91](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-91)
Central Europe delivered a strong performance, notably due to the significant progress recorded in Germany. [#92](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-92)

Organic growth was strong at plus 7.7%, driven by good commercial momentum in workwear across the board with Germany posting a plus 15% growth in this business line in H1. [#93](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-93)

Additionally, the significant wage inflation in the region led to material price increase and the acquisition of Moderna consolidated since the beginning of March 24 contributed another plus 3.6% to the region's growth in H1. [#95](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-95)
EBITDA margin showed significant improvement, up plus 180 bps compared to the same period last year at 31.3%. [#96](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-96)

Again, Germany was especially strong with margin improvement by 350 bps in the semester following some organizational management changes in the country. [#97](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-97)
Furthermore, energy purchasing conditions improved in the first half compared to last year. [#98](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-98)
This also contributed to the margin expansion. [#99](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-99)
Moving on to the next slide, also organic growth and margin in Scandinavia and Eastern Europe are solid. [#100](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-100)
It is the only region where margin went down in the first half. [#101](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-101)

Organic growth was driven by the performance of Sweden and the Baltics, where the outsourcing trend continues, but Denmark was tougher with some exceptional losses due to our pricing discipline. [#102](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-102)
EBITDA margin remained high in H1 at close to 35%, but decreased minus 50 bps. [#103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-103)

We have a significant number of clients in the public sector in Sweden and Denmark whose contracts have a specific and unusual clause that make pricing adjustments less flexible than in our standard contract. [#104](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-104)
This is a small drag for margin in the region. [#105](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-105)
Moving on to the next slide. [#107](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-107)
The U.K. and Ireland continue to be well oriented with solid organic growth, plus 5.1% and significant EBITDA margin improvement. [#108](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-108)
The reinforcement of our sales team has paid off with many successes in workwear for both health care and industry clients. [#109](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-109)
Pricing was also a significant top line growth driver in the context of significantly wage increase in the region. [#110](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-110)
EBITDA margin was 31.1%, up plus 130 bps. [#111](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-111)

With a favorable evolution in our energy purchasing conditions as well as continuous productivity gains on industrial processes and logistics. [#112](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-112)

Moving on to the next Slide performance in Latin America was also very satisfactory with organic rose growth at plus 7.5% and EBITDA margin close to 5%. [#113](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-113)
Mexico continued to be very strong with organic growth of around 10% and a record level of EBITDA margin at 42%. [#114](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-114)

Latin America continues to offer many growth prospects with a steady outsourcing trend occurring in workwear for industry and plate for health care, where we continue to see hospitals closing their internal laundry and switching to outsourcing. [#115](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-115)
Next slide, next region, Southern Europe posted very significant EBITDA margin in the first half, up 250 bps up 2%. [#117](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-117)

The organic performance of plus 6.6% was driven by good commercial mental in workwear and strong activity in hospitality, which, by the way, looks very promising for the summer, too. [#118](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-118)

On top of this volume uplift, the better purchasing condition of energy and further productivity gains led to around 250 bps margin improvement to nearly 32%. [#119](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-119)
Moving on to the next slide. [#120](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-120)
We acquired Moderna, a quite big company in the Netherlands at the end of February. [#121](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-121)

Moderna is a EUR 50 million top line business, which provides flat linen, workwear and hygiene and well-being services to clients in the hospitality, industrial and trade and services industry. [#122](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-122)

This acquisition complements Elis existing network in the Netherlands, especially in the dynamic workwear market and allows the group to address the flat-level market in the country, which was not the case before. [#123](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-123)

The business generated 26% EBITDA and 13% EBIT margin in '23, with a lower share of rental services than the group average, and therefore, less textile amortization. [#124](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-124)
It is consolidated in our accounts since the beginning of March. [#125](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-125)
Its integration is going very well and is perfectly on track. [#126](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-126)
Moderna employs around 400 people and operates a plot that is very modern and has been very well invested in the last few years. [#128](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-128)
This plant, which has become 1 of the largest of the group is located in the northeastern region of the country. [#129](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-129)
close to the German border and can address the entire Dutch territory since to the 2 supply center. [#130](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-130)

This network combined with the elite network in the country that was already very dense leaves room for very significant logistic optimization going forward. [#131](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-131)
Moving on to the next slide to conclude on M&A. [#132](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-132)
We also announced the acquisition of 1 way in Malaysia, early July. [#133](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-133)
One was a family business that was founded in the '80s. [#134](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-134)
The group employs around 200 employees and can address the entire Manager and territory, thanks to 3 specialized laundries. [#135](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-135)

It provides high usable garment services in clean room to mainly international groups operating in semiconductors, medical devices and chemical industries. [#137](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-137)
In 2023, delivered revenue close to EUR 6 million. [#138](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-138)
It is, therefore, a small acquisition, but with interesting prospects going forward. [#139](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-139)
given the very strong momentum of the firm market in Malaysia. [#140](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-140)
Additionally, this acquisition reinforced Elis' leadership position in the global home market. [#141](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-141)

So this is the end of the first part of the presentation, and let me now hand over to Louis, who will give you more color on our first half financial performance. [#142](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-142)
Thank you, Xavier. [#144](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-144)
Good evening, everyone. [#145](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-145)

Let me first go through the usual revenue breakdown by activity and market and geography to illustrate the group's high level of diversification which provides us with a highly resilient model in terms of crisis. [#146](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-146)

Which in the way you look at these graphs, you will see that Elis positioning is well balanced, which contributes significantly with resilience. [#147](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-147)
In terms of activity, flatline and workwear are generally represent 47% and 17% of revenue, respectively. [#148](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-148)

Looking at our end markets, Hospitality is now back to a normalized level on our 4 end markets, which all have different growth drivers, which mostly account for 1 quarter of our activity, which is a key strength in times of crisis. [#149](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-149)
in terms of geographies. [#150](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-150)

France represents now only 30% of our total turnover, and we have a balanced mix with on the 1 hand, Central Europe, coming out here being more mature on the other hand, Southern Europe, Latin America, offering higher growth prospects. [#151](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-151)
With good diversification in terms of activity client geographies does not come about by chance. [#153](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-153)
It is a consequence of a long-term strategy backed by product innovation, commercial efficiency and M&A. [#154](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-154)
Moving to the next slide. [#155](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-155)
Let's have a look now at revenue growth and the EBITDA margin by geography. [#156](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-156)
As explained by air the growth of 6.9% is strong. [#157](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-157)

It encompassed 1% of M&A with mainly Moderna, 0.4% of positive ForEx on the back of the recovery of currencies like British pound, and last 5.5% of organic growth. [#158](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-158)
The organic growth embedded in majority price, as inflation is still high in several countries like Germany, U.K. and Spain. [#159](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003194583-159)
